Name: Thunderous Leap
Description:
You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range. Immediately after you disappear, a thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d10 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The thunder can be heard from up to 300 feet away.

You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn’t exceed what you can carry. You can also teleport one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to their carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell, and there must be an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your destination space for the creature to appear in. Otherwise, the creature is left behind.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 3rd:

• The damage increases by 1d10.
• The spell’s range increases by 40 feet.
• The range within which a creature can be selected to come with you, the range they can be deposited, and the range within which creatures may take damage all increase by 5 feet.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
